key_insight: Strong performance on isolated medical tasks did not translate into reliable patient-level reasoning: strict CarePath success peaked at 23% among 21 multimodal models.
clinical_relevance: NPCBench evaluates whether AI can integrate visual evidence and changing patient states across nasopharyngeal carcinoma care pathways, rather than answer isolated questions.
method: Mirror specialist training through foundational knowledge, case planning, longitudinal review, CarePath integration, and consultation.
Score whether diagnostic and care answers are jointly correct within each patient’s pathway.
Use paired controls and physician calibration to examine evidence grounding, longitudinal revision, and consultation judging.
evidence_signal: Evaluation covered 30 models using 4,777 component and consultation items plus a 100-patient CarePath cohort with 417 scored diagnostic and care tasks.
watch_item: This disease-specific benchmark does not establish real-world clinical safety or generalizability to other cancers or care settings.
paper_title: NPCBench: A Clinical Apprenticeship Benchmark for Multimodal Care-Pathway Reasoning in Nasopharyngeal Carcinoma
